summary: Coeur d'Alene NF lookout: 1931 cabin and pole tower, 1963 R-6 tower moved to Black Mountain in 1975 or 1976; cabin burned in the 2010s; remnants on the summit.

facts.design: R-6 cab on a 53-foot treated timber tower (1963 to 1975); the 1931 structure was a 48-foot pole tower with a 7x7 cab and log cabin
facts.status_note: Cabin burned in the 2010s; the R-6 tower moved to Black Mountain Lookout in 1975 (1976 on one source)

access.note: Our inference: the Idaho Fire Lookouts page says you can still drive to the top and calls it a popular riding destination; no closure, permit or owner is stated in any source read

visit.drive_up: Idaho Fire Lookouts says you can still drive to the top

corrections.why: 14.6 m is 48 feet, the height of the 1931 pole tower. The R-6 tower that the record describes (built 1963) is 53 feet, about 16.2 m, per firelookout.com and the Weebly page.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com, the Weebly page, the Faset page on Idaho Fire Lookouts and NHLR give 1975 for the move to Black Mountain. The Black Mountain page on Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 1976. The story reports 1975 with the 1976 variant noted.

notes_for_editor: The brief's height 14.6 m matches the 48-foot 1931 pole tower, not the R-6 tower; see the correction. The move year differs (1975 vs 1976). The cabin burned in the 2010s; sources give only that decade, so no event year is set for the fire. Staffing is a partial list of known personnel (1948 to 1972), not a roster. Access 'public' is our inference from the riding description. The Idaho Fire Lookouts Black Mountain page says 'Drive-Up Moved' and gives a 2019 move; its current status and whether the rental program opened are not confirmed by any source read. A reader comment on the Faset page is not used. No photos added.
